title: Pasqal Inaugurates SOL (140-qubit Orion neutral-atom QPU) at CINECA, Italy
summary: Pasqal's 140-qubit Orion analog Rydberg neutral-atom QPU inaugurated at CINECA (Italy), coupled to the Leonardo EuroHPC supercomputer; Europe's third Pasqal system.
actionable: Second analog-Rydberg vendor in the HYP-017/018/019 family; correct modality but no error/fidelity specs and no MERA/holography hooks. Backup analog platform only; revisit if specs publish.
